findings.title: Rate-limit bypass via X-Forwarded-For spoofing
findings.detail: Created 8/8 accounts by rotating XFF — trust proxy config needed

findings.title: Webhook URLs not restricted (SSRF risk)
findings.detail: PRO users can set webhook URL to http://169.254.169.254, http://localhost, file internals — worker fetch has no blocklist

findings.title: Login rate-limit is per-email in authorize(), not hard lockout with backoff UI
findings.detail: 10 attempts / 30 capacity — credential stuffing still feasible across IPs; no CAPTCHA after N fails

findings.title: Coupon redemptions++ happens before successful Stripe checkout
findings.detail: In checkout route, coupon.redemptions increments immediately — abandoned checkouts burn coupon quota (business logic bug)

findings.title: Host header used for Stripe success/cancel URLs (open redirect / phishing)
findings.detail: checkout-one-time publicOrigin() trusts X-Forwarded-Host — attacker can point Stripe return to evil.com if they control a published pageId

findings.title: Internal resolve-host is publicly callable
findings.detail: status=404 — enables domain enumeration / cache probing

findings.title: No page id for Alice — skip IDOR/form tests
